notes.title: An Update on Projekt Z's Release
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

Your feedback and excitement have inspired us to think big with Projekt Z.

We’re expanding the scope, exploring new features, and raising the quality bar for every part of the experience. To make that happen, we’re shifting our launch to 2026.

This extra time will let us deliver the game we’ve always envisioned, and the one you deserve. We know delays aren’t fun, but we truly believe the wait will be worth it.

In the meantime, there’s a lot to look forward to:

We’ll be at Gamescom this year at an off-site event, showing to media and creators the very first chapter of Projekt Z.

Playtests are already underway, with more slots opening soon (under NDA for now).

Thank you for sticking with us through this journey. Your support means everything, and we can’t wait to share more in the months ahead.

notes.title: Devlog #8 Is Here – Big Changes and New Features
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors, 

It’s been a while… but we’re back with a brand new Devlog for Projekt Z: Beyond Order! In Devlog #8, we’re pulling back the curtain on the major progress we’ve made in recent months—including a reworked Hideout system, overhauled weapon mechanics, new zombie variants, character abilities, and more. 

[previewyoutube=Kbf5eSHqBxQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re opening up our Focus Test group to more players. Interested in playtesting? Click the link in the video description to apply. 

🎥 Watch the full Devlog #8 now and catch up on everything we’ve been working on! 

Wishlist Projekt Z to keep up with the latest news about playtests, releases and more!
